name: Evil Recruit 2 ~Hero Nante Hedemonai~
original_name: イビルリクルート2～ヒーローなんて屁でもない～
source:
Sakura and Aoi were women with farts so smelly they had a hard time fitting in anywhere... Until they joined Asterism, a secret society. They fought off their enemies with their farts and managed to rejoin society gracefully.

It's been 3 months since then. And a speedy promotion awaits them. But their troubles haven't ended. Now they'll have to face the rage of their coworkers, going on strike for what they believe is an unfit promotion; their superiors, challenging them to a duel, and a new organization of heroes, Clean Force, who they'll have to face.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01234253.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
小樱和葵是放屁很臭的女人，她们在任何地方都很难融入……直到她们加入了秘密社团Asterism。他们用屁击退了敌人，并优雅地重返社会。

从那以后已经过去3个月了。等待他们的是快速晋升。但他们的麻烦还没有结束。现在，他们将不得不面对同事的愤怒，并因他们认为不合适的升职而举行罢工；他们的上级向他们发起决斗挑战，他们还必须面对一个新的英雄组织“清洁力量”。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01234253.html]DLsite English[/url]]
